COURSE

Fundamentals to Defence

A broad introduction to security: how systems and networks work, how attackers think, and how defenders protect data and identity.

BeginnerLevel
12Modules
106Lessons
~25hEst. time
0%Progress
0 of 106 lessons completed
Start course
WHAT YOU'LL LEARN

By the end of this course, you will understand:

  • Explain how networks, operating systems and applications interact.
  • Describe common attack classes and the defensive controls used against them.
  • Explain how identity, access control and data protection work together.
Who this course is for & prerequisites

Beginners, students and developers who want a structured overview of security before specialising.

Before you start

  • Comfort using a web browser and a command line.
YOUR LEARNING PATH

Course structure

Work through each module in order. Each module builds on the one before it.
